# JOURNALY (journaly.in) — Full AI & Agent Context Document

## Overview
JOURNALY (https://journaly.in) is an Indian brand specializing in structured 5-minute daily guided, gratitude, and manifestation journals. The brand's mission is to help people build a sustainable daily journaling habit, calm morning overthinking, stop phone doomscrolling, and record meaningful life memories.

## Research Partner: IntelligentLab
Every journal includes calibrated daily questions researched and engineered by IntelligentLab.
Key findings:
- 9 out of 10 people successfully establish a consistent daily reflection habit using this format.
- Traditional blank diaries create cognitive fatigue and blank-page dread; IntelligentLab's structured morning (3 mins) and evening (2 mins) questions remove all friction.
- Morning prompts anchor single-priority focus, gratitude, and intention before opening work apps or social media.
- Evening prompts facilitate cognitive closure, acknowledge a quiet win, and release daily tension for restful sleep.

## Customer Guarantees & Policies
- 60-Day Empty-Book Guarantee: Write in the journal for 60 days. If the five-minute habit doesn't deliver clarity, keep the book and receive a 100% full refund in rupees.
- Shipping: Free express courier delivery across all Indian pin codes via BlueDart Express and Delhivery Surface. Delivery timeframe: 3–5 business days.
- Payments: 100% prepaid online via Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking). No cash on delivery.
- Live Tracking: Real-time parcel tracking available on https://journaly.in/track-order using Order ID (format: `JRN-XXXXX`) or registered mobile number.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Reference)
Q: How long does journaling actually take each day?
A: Exactly 5 minutes. 3 minutes in the morning with tea or coffee, and 2 minutes in the evening before sleeping.

Q: What if I have failed at journaling before?
A: 9 out of 10 people who previously failed with blank notebooks build a lasting habit with JOURNALY. The questions designed by IntelligentLab give immediate direction so you never have to stare at a blank page.

Q: Is cash on delivery available?
A: No, JOURNALY operates exclusively with secure digital prepaid payments through Razorpay to ensure zero-contact express fulfillment.

Q: How can I track my shipment?
A: Visit https://journaly.in/track-order and enter your Order ID or phone number to see live status from BlueDart or Delhivery.
